summary: Tested 4 UI fixes for CBP Training Assistant. All features working correctly: chat area scrolling (min-h-0 + overflow-y-auto), chat history popup dialog (Dialog component with Q&A preview), dynamic sidebar updates (fetchSessions called after REST fallback), and overall layout renders correctly.

minor.issue: PostgreSQL was not running - had to install and start it manually. Database migrations were not applied.
WebSocket connection fails with 502 error. REST fallback works correctly but takes 60+ seconds due to Ollama cold start.
minor.priority: LOW - Expected behavior, REST fallback works

issues: Shows 'Disconnected' (red) even when REST API is working. This is because WebSocket fails but REST fallback succeeds. Consider showing 'Connected (REST)' or similar to avoid user confusion.

critical_code_review_comments: ChatArea.jsx Line 213: min-h-0 fix correctly applied for flex overflow
Sidebar.jsx: Dialog component properly fetches session data from /api/sessions/{id}/
App.js: fetchSessions() is useCallback and called after stream_complete and REST fallback - working correctly

success_rate.backend: 100% (sessions API, chat API working after PostgreSQL fix)

seed_data_creation: Created 2 test chat sessions via API and UI
context_for_next_testing_agent: PostgreSQL must be running for sessions API to work. WebSocket fails in preview environment but REST fallback works. LLM responses take 60+ seconds due to Ollama cold start. All 4 UI fixes verified working.

chat_area_scrolling.details: ChatArea.jsx has min-h-0 on container (line 213) and overflow-y-auto on messages area (line 219). Verified via Playwright that overflow-y: auto is applied.

chat_history_popup_dialog.details: Clicking sidebar chat history item opens Dialog component. Dialog fetches session data from /api/sessions/{id}/ and displays Q&A pairs. 'Open Full Chat' button loads full session.

dynamic_chat_history_update.details: After sending message and receiving response via REST fallback, sidebar chat history count increased from 1 to 2 without page refresh. fetchSessions() is called after REST response.

overall_layout.details: Sidebar, header (CBP Training Assistant), chat area, and input bar all render correctly. Welcome message displays on empty chat.

environment_fixes_applied.postgresql: Installed postgresql, created frds_db database and frds_user, ran Django migrations
